workflow.title: Review app leftovers before uninstalling a Mac app
workflow.primaryIntent: Decide which app-associated files to keep before uninstalling, rather than treating all large app data as junk.
workflow.descriptionBrief: Lead with the distinction between removing an app and reclaiming storage; paths and backups matter more than the advertised completeness claim. Vendor documentation, not a hands-on tutorial.
sections: Define the goal: uninstall, reset, update or investigate growth
Read the proposed file paths and separate service files from original documents
Use Nektony's documented bundle-ID/file-review workflow without promising completeness
If the app is staying, investigate storage instead of uninstalling it
Choose the narrower tool and preserve unknowns
workflow.interactionPass: Non-executing keep/reset/uninstall decision checklist. Never scan, remove files or invoke cleanup from an article. No invented results or arbitrary demo repo.
workflow.visualPlan: Official Applications-tab image immediately after lead, only after rights approval; current-source Breathing Room Space example image later with full caption.
workflow.distinctFromBundle: Focus app-associated file decisions, not MacCleaner Pro's whole-disk/duplicate toolkit; no duplicate alternatives route.

comparison.title: Breathing Room vs Nektony App Cleaner & Uninstaller
comparison.primaryIntent: Choose an app manager/uninstaller versus storage investigation and reviewable care, without claiming feature parity.
comparison.leadBrief: Choose the documented Nektony workflow for uninstalling/updating apps; consider Breathing Room, which we build, for storage investigation if its preview/runtime and hosted-AI boundaries fit.
